title: Installer Visit Records, Missed Visits and Delay Credits — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
On Ridgeline Installation Services contracts the installer records every measure, installation and warranty service visit with its outcome. The visit record, not the customer's or the installer's later account, decides what follows. The recorded outcomes are: completed as scheduled, installer no-show, customer absent (customer no-show) and site not ready.

## Customer-side failed visits

> An installation or warranty visit that cannot proceed because the customer was absent or the site was not ready incurs the program's trip charge, subject to the same-address coordination of trip charges — this clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis for the failed-visit trip charge.

## Installer no-show

A scheduled installation or warranty visit the installer missed earns the program's installer no-show credit, and the visit is rebooked without any reschedule fee.

## Delay credit

When installation starts more than the program's delay threshold days, in calendar days, after the original installation date, and no customer reschedule, customer no-show or site-not-ready visit occurred in between, the delay is on Ridgeline's or the installer's side and earns the program's delay credit. The delay credit and installer no-show credits on the same contract do not stack: the customer receives the larger, so the delay credit posted is the program's delay credit less the installer no-show credits already posted on the contract, and none when that is not above zero.

| Hypothetical contract (delay threshold 14 days) | Start of installation | Customer-side event in between | No-show credits already posted | Program delay credit | Delay credit posted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | 15 days after the original date | none | 0.00 | 150.00 | 150.00 |
| B | 15 days after the original date | none | 100.00 | 150.00 | 50.00 |
| C | 15 days after the original date | none | 200.00 | 150.00 | none |
| D | 14 days after the original date | none | 0.00 | 150.00 | none (not more than the threshold) |

## Repeated customer no-shows

When the number of installation visits recorded with the customer absent reaches the program's customer no-show count, Ridgeline may cancel the contract with the reason "customer no-show" and the cancellation fee of the cancellation fee terms.

superseded_clauses: An installation or warranty visit that cannot proceed because the customer was absent (customer_no_show) or the site was not ready (site_not_ready) incurs trip_charge_usd, subject to install_agg_same_address.
